promotions.name: Stadtwerke Goettingen AG
promotions.resolution: Fresh Mobilithek/DATEX II records supplied by chargecloud resolve the previously missing anonymous ad-hoc fee matrix by power class: AC 0.46 EUR/kWh + 1.50 EUR start + 0.06 EUR/min after 240 min; DC 50 kW and HPC 150 kW 0.52 EUR/kWh + 2.50 EUR start + 0.06 EUR/min after 120 min. Mixed AC/DC station Am Geismartor independently exposes both fee classes on the same operator/backend dataset, and Gallus-Park confirms the HPC class.

boundedProgress.result: No promotion this batch. Existing residual task remains exact EVSE-to-zone/power/fee reconciliation; generic tariff research was not repeated.

chargecloud.result: Mobilithek/DATEX II station-level records expose anonymous tariff components by EVSE/power class sufficiently to close Goettingen. This validates chargecloud-derived AFIR records as a reusable read-only evidence path for compatible B1/B3/B6 CPOs, subject to per-CPO coverage checks.

nextSafeAction: Continue exact Allgaeuer residual reconciliation, then apply the validated chargecloud/Mobilithek fee-component pattern in batch to classified B1/B3/B6 CPOs before moving to the next backend family.
